verified: SAFETY boxed title, PAUSED, SAFETY / CLEAR; DECO blue label over depth and minutes (manual Rev B p.58-60)
Active gas on the Main Screen, Standard and Main: AI bottom row: the breathing gas's O2 percentage (32%), O2/He for a trimix (18/50), from the log (PDF p.27)

CC page: the Tec layout with SP in the centre slot, green high / magenta low, PPO2 there on a bailout; CC green / BO yellow badges (Rev B PDF p.42, p.85, p.87); loop PPO2 limits 0.40 / 1.60 (PDF p.41)
Info pages: one page per info screen, in the manual order, each replacing the bottom row of the main page (Rev B PDF p.37 figure)
Info: AI - T1 pressure, GTR, SAC, grey T1 tags (PDF p.37, p.38 T1 & GTR/SAC)

Main: AI page: the Main Screen with T1 in the configurable slot and the Info: AI row's GTR and SAC (with their grey T1 tags) in the bottom row's centre and right positions, the gas kept on the left (bottom row options, PDF p.27; GTR / SAC p.38); on a sidemount dive the Main Screen's sidemount variant already shows the AI row
Info: CNS / MOD / PPO2, PPO2 as .21 (PDF p.37, p.41-42); CC page Info: CNS / MOD / DilPO2 (PDF p.37, p.41)
Info: GF / GF99 / TTS - GF setting 50/85, GF99 with %, TTS in minutes (PDF p.37, p.43-44)
Info: TEMP / BATTERY (PDF p.37, p.40, p.46); Info: PRESSURE mBar SURF / NOW (PDF p.37, p.46-47); Info: DATE / CLOCK (PDF p.37, p.46)
Gauge page: Standard / Big layout - depth, time, STOPWATCH (green while running) top right, CLOCK, GA badge, MAX / AVG bottom row, no NDL and no tissue bar (PDF p.88-89)

Sidemount (Tec page and Info: AI): the Tec centre row T1 | SurfGF | T2 with the green switch box on the label of the tank to breathe from (Rev B PDF p.113, SM Switch 21 bar), and the AI row T1 | GTR / SM / SAC | T2 (PDF p.112 combination table); on the Main Screen and Standard pages the AI row is the info row (PDF p.22, p.112)
assumed: Text sizes measured from the manual's figures as a share of the screen height and drawn in Roboto Condensed, the narrowest bundled font, standing in for the device's own: Main / Standard / Main: AI from the Standard layout figure (PDF p.69 Descent: depth 0.295, dive time 0.221 with small seconds, NDL label 0.092 / value 0.145, slot and row labels 0.08-0.096, values 0.145, gas % 0.087, gas badge 0.145 tall), Tec / CC from PDF p.23 (labels 0.08, values 0.163, TIME and TTS in whole minutes), Gauge from PDF p.89; wide values (18/50, 4-digit psi, 1013 mBar) are shrunk to their cells

Main and Standard are both the Standard layout (the owner's choice; the Big layout with bold depth and NDL and the vertical N/D/L label is not drawn); the TIME, T1, BAR and MAX labels painted into the skins are replaced by drawn labels, the TIME label dropped as on the manual's figures, NDL without the 'min' tag
Info pages: title and value sizes match the Standard bottom row, column positions approximated from the PDF p.37 figure
Info: TEMP shows one decimal in metric (the figure shows whole degrees), battery as a percent from the log
Info: PRESSURE - surface 1013 mbar and now from depth (salt water), not the logged barometer
Gauge: STOPWATCH shows the dive time - a log records no stopwatch start or reset; the stopwatch title is always green (running)
Gauge: no TIME label, as on the figure; the figure shows no temperature, so none is drawn
Sidemount: the tank icons' size and the GTR / SM / SAC spacing approximated from the PDF p.112 figure

Sidemount Main Screen and Standard: MAX in the configurable slot (the manual shows no sidemount figure of these layouts; MAX is one of the slot's options, PDF p.147), no gas or compass on the info row while it shows the AI row
not_shown: Info screens LAST DIVE (surface only), Compass (no heading in the logs) and TISSUES (no tissue-graph element) (PDF p.37-39, p.48-49)
Info: AI three- and four-transmitter rows (PDF p.112), RTR (PDF p.112)
Gauge: the Tec-layout gauge screen, RATE, resettable average depth, stopwatch stopped (red) state (PDF p.88-89)
